title: Synch AAPS and NS Client not working
symptom: AAPS does not upload data to Nightscout site anymore, showing error 'io.socket.engineio.client.EngineIOException: xhr poll error'. The app and site work well, and xdrip sends glucose data to Nightscout and AAPS, but AAPS is not syncing with Nightscout. Inserting carbs or insulin in AAPS does not appear on Nightscout.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak suggests it is a connection issue to the server, possibly NS or internet issue, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The thread does not provide a resolution. Users tried older versions and restarting but the problem persisted.
